full_page.content:
1932, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 22 Cont.
Feb. 15 Rent or Sell Baby - 18 mo. Eczema cured
Joseph Yanowitz - 46 - Jewish - Paralysis of arm.
Edw'd Wesley 22 of Windsor - Convulsions Mrs. W. S. Quinlan - Cleveland - property to sell before swallowed up.
Mary Ryan
Page 23 Feb. Unjust Lawsuits - two
Four Operations for cancer, promised afterwards - if nothing malig- nent. Asks to thank God for favorable report.
Marg. Dowd with 2 children - 4 months in Kiefer Hosp. T.B.
Mrs. Babot - non cath. 35 - 2 small children - Dr's want operation for cancer - She wants to get out of it - I want to- enrolled To- day perpetually.
Feb. 24
Tubucular Bone - Len Breuer - 34 - of Averhill Court - wife and three small children .. unable to work since last March ... was to have another operation a week ago. Came to Blessing of the relic instead of going to operation. Dr. surprised at improvement. Baby Jose. Fr. Barry - 2 months old - half blind.
Simon Goulah - 45 - Fractured skull. Wife & 3 small children August 25, 1932 - To-day Mr. Goulah came to monastery with whole family. Is well except for a lame back received from an "orderly" in Rec. Hospital. - Got kick April 18 just before leaving ... laxetive .... Jan. 23, 1934 Mrs. Goulah in To-day ... Husband O.K. - working every day.
Page 24 Feb. 24 Andrew Tomas - 48 - was unable to work 8 months, had not been to confession since married 25 years before Was enrolled last Decem- ber. At once improved, went to Sacraments and is zealous & O.K.
Marcellus Viaene - 10 - deaf had spinal maningitis
